svg.aria-label: Minimap mapping: world units to grid cells to minimap pixels
svg.title: Minimap mapping: world units to grid cells to minimap pixels
svg.text: How the minimap shrinks the whole maze into a small square
The little line shows where you face: (cos a, sin a) x 13 px
where a is the player's turning angle.
Row 0 is drawn at the bottom, like looking down from above. Drawing it at the top made a mirror image (bug #3).
